newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-UNDERWOOD PULLS OUT OF ENGLAND TEAM.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-UNDERWOOD PULLS OUT OF ENGLAND TEAM.

text.p: British Lions' winger Tony Underwood has withdrawn from the England side to play Australia on Saturday because of a hip injury.
Underwood joins three other Lions -- centre Jeremy Guscott, prop Jason Leonard and lock Martin Johnson -- who are unavailable for the one-off test. He will be replaced by Nick Beal.
"It's a pity their top players aren't here," said Wallaby coach Greg Smith. "But I tend to think the England team is very good.
"Their back row is very attacking. They're fast, big powerful men and they're very damaging. Given a good platform from the tight five they are people to fear."
England coach Jack Rowell said jet-lag could prove a factor in the match.
"It's not an overnight thing, it's still a threat," Rowell said.

England - 15-Tim Stimpson; 14-John Bentley, 13-Phil de Glanville (captain), 12-Nick Greenstock, 11-Tony Underwood; 10-Mike Catt, 9-Matthew Dawson; 8-Tim Rodber, 7-Richard Hill, 6-Lawrence Dallaglio, 5-Simon Shaw, 4-Nigel Redman, 3-Darren Garforth, 2-Mark Regan, 1-Graham Rowntree.

Australia - 15-Matthew Burke; 14-Joe Roff, 13-Jason Little, 12-James Holbeck, 11-Ben Tune; 10-Tim Horan, 9-George Gregan; 8-Troy Coker, 7-Brett Robinson, 6-Daniel Manu, 5-John Eales (captain), 4-Garrick Morgan, 3-Cameron Blades, 2-Michael Foley, 1-Ewen McKenzie.
